fusions.name: Batted About
fusions.desc: Bats the target from one end of the staff to the other. It deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Unseen Sweep
fusions.desc: A low sweep of the staff through a cone 3.5 tiles long. It deals 26 damage to everything in it, and every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Fence-Top Walk
fusions.desc: You carry the staff crosswise for balance. Your movement speed rises by 30% for 6 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Lands on Three Feet
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
